jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Are you ready to drive impactful change in a dynamic environment? As Project Manager - PPM H2R, you will shape organizational structures, methods, and digital governance across all GBS Process Management Hire to Retire towers, ensuring optimal activity distribution.
You will act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders, strengthening delivery and process excellence while maintaining strong project governance. In this collaborative role, you will contribute to the success of strategic GBS initiatives and play a key part in transforming processes for the future.
Tasks & responsibilities

- You will lead strategic, tactical, and organizational priority projects across GBS PM H2R, with a strong focus on Payroll and Time management.
- By promoting agile ways of working, such as Scrum and Lean methodologies, you will actively support the transformation toward a more agile GBS organization.
- You will establish PMO standards, methods, and governance frameworks to ensure consistent project execution across GBS PM H2R, following the official project framework (GBS united).
- Through continuous improvement initiatives, you will optimize end-to-end GBS processes, ensuring efficiency, standardization, and scalability.
- To strengthen operational excellence, you will define and implement process frameworks, workflows, and governance models that align with organizational goals.
- Your role will include supporting the assessment and preparation of decision papers and value cases, enabling informed and impactful decision-making.

Requirements

- Master's or diploma degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Business Administration or Industrial Engineering
- Solid GBS and Payroll & Time knowledge (processes, operating model, governance, methodologies) and ability to drive innovation and organizational change
- Highly motivated team player with strong analytical and conceptual skills, able to thrive in international, cross functional settings
- Proven consulting and project management experience (agile and traditional, e.g., Scrum Master, Agile Coach) is a plus
- Capability to deep dive into collaborative working models and IT tools, and translate insights effectively into the GBS environment
- Excellent communication, leadership, and influencing skills, with strong English proficiency

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package. Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.

BLISSAIR, based in Bocholt, Germany, is an aviation company, providing customized air transport solutions and aviation services.

BLISSAIR stands for safe, fast, and comfortable private air travel worldwide, delivered through our own aircraft fleet as well as an extensive network of partner aircraft.

Our facilities in Bocholt have recently been expanded to include a CAE Full-Flight Simulator for the King Air B200 equipped with a Pro Line 21 cockpit. A second simulator is already in the planning stage.

The simulator provides a highly realistic representation of the aircraft and is certified to the highest qualification standard, Level D. This gives BLISSAIR a unique market position, as it is the only simulator of its kind in Europe.

To support the ongoing maintenance and operation of this simulator, we are looking for an enthusiastic aviation-minded team player to join us as soon as possible.

Your Profile

- Completed vocational training as an Aircraft Electronics Technician, Electronics Technician, Mechatronics Technician, a comparable technical qualification, or a degree in an engineering or technical field.
- Good computer skills, particularly with Windows operating systems and older computer hardware
- Good IT skills, basic network setup and understanding of network protocols.
- Familiarity with technologies such as RS-232, Ethernet, Fibre Optics and Microcontrollers.
- Ability to repair and replace hardware components, perform soldering and rework, troubleshoot and diagnose electrical and electronic faults, trace wiring and signal paths, measure and test electrical circuits using diagnostic equipment, interpret electrical schematics, and carry out component-level repairs
- Ability to work independently with a high level of personal responsibility.
- Knowledge of C++ programming language and experience in the aviation industry are an advantage.
- Fluent in spoken and written english
- Quick learner with strong teamwork skills, initiative, and enthusiasm.
- Strong interest in technical systems and aviation industry

Your Responsibilities

- Work as part of the simulator maintenance team.
- Independently perform maintenance and servicing of simulator hardware, including quality checks.
- Provide technical support during customer training operations.
- Analyze and diagnose faults, carry out repairs.
- Document maintenance activities, inspections, and quality checks.

What We Offer

- A friendly working environment in a small team with an open, collaborative culture and flat hierarchies.
- A responsible and varied role with exciting technical challenges.
- The opportunity to work on a unique Level D King Air B200 simulator—the only one of its kind in Europe.
- A positive workplace atmosphere and modern facilities.
- The chance to contribute to internal process improvements and help plan and implement the company's second simulator.

Collaborating closely with medicinal chemists, structural biologists, biologists, and data engineers, you will drive discovery project milestones and advance our digital transformation in R&D. Your role is crucial in shaping the future of drug discovery and development through innovative digital solutions.

- 
Applying cutting‑edge quantum mechanics methods to advance drug development and to generate a deep understanding of molecular interactions is central to your function

- You lead strategic digital initiatives and actively co‑shape the R&D digital strategy.
- Working closely with the Data Science & AI unit to leverage next‑generation technologies and drive the adoption of digital solutions is a core part of your role
- You share your skills and knowledge by coaching and teaching others, demonstrating collaborative and supportive behaviors.
- You contribute to self‑directed teams that work collaboratively and align with Bayer’s leadership standards.

WHO YOU ARE

- You hold a PhD in quantum chemistry, computational chemistry, chemistry, computer science, or a related discipline, with strong knowledge of organic chemistry.
- Demonstrated success in an industry setting defines your professional track record, supported by extensive professional experience where you have utilized a diverse range of ligand‑ and structure‑based approaches, including virtual screening, docking, molecular dynamics, binding‑affinity calculations, generative design approaches, and holistic workflows
- You are proficient in quantum mechanics software such as ORCA and xTB, and you have experience in scripting, programming, and workflow automation
- You have experience working with AI‑driven DMTA loops in a pharmaceutical setting, as well as practical exposure to computational workflows that integrate AI, modeling, and chemistry

- Curiosity, creativity, and a strong passion for drug discovery are central characteristics that define you
- Fluency in English (written and spoken), with strong communication skills and the ability to present complex data clearly and effectively, round off your profile

This position can be filled on a full-time or near full-time (min. 80%) basis.
